_comment: Per-machine config. config.json is gitignored; copy this file to config.json and adjust paths. The box (guppy) keeps its own config.json with local paths.

codegen._comment: OpenAI-compatible model that writes runnable skill bodies. Larger/slower than the decision or self-assessment model. No max_tokens cap: qwen38-iq3s reasons extensively (~7 min) before emitting the body; reasoning is filtered automatically. timeout is seconds.
